deskripsi: A whimsical twist on form and color, featuring a long, yellow-colored pig that stretches with an almost comical elongation. It celebrates individuality and the delightful surprises that come with embracing one’s unique characteristics. Its exaggerated form challenges conventional perspectives, inviting viewers to  appreciate the humor and creativity inherent in everyday objects, highlighting the importance of humor and creativity in life, suggesting that growth and self-expression can be joyful processes.
